brief.zh: 黑变白、白变黑：输出 = 1 − 输入。
brief.en: Black becomes white, white becomes black: output = 1 − input.

hint.zh: 先把所有数乘 −1，再整体加上一个数。
hint.en: First multiply every number by −1, then add one number to all of them.

after.zh: 每个像素各算各的，互不打扰。这叫逐像素运算：它改变亮度，却永远不知道邻居是谁。
after.en: Each pixel is worked out on its own, leaving the others alone. This is a per-pixel operation: it changes brightness, but never knows who its neighbours are.

t.zh: 胶片相机的底片上，明暗是反的：天空发黑，白衬衫发暗。冲印时再反一次，才变回正常。医生看 X 光片时，也常在正片和负片之间切换。
t.en: On a film camera's negative, light and dark are reversed: the sky looks black and a white shirt looks dark. Printing reverses them again to bring the picture back to normal. Doctors reading X-rays also often switch between positive and negative.

t.zh: 在数字图里，反相就是把每格的数换掉：0 变 1，1 变 0，0.3 变 0.7。照片还是那张照片，只是明暗颠倒。
t.en: In a digital image, inverting means replacing the number in every cell: 0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0, 0.3 becomes 0.7. The photo is still the same photo, just with light and dark swapped.

t.zh: 为什么是「1 减去输入」？亮度都在 0 到 1 之间。只把每格乘 −1，暗的 0.3 会变成 −0.3，亮的 0.9 会变成 −0.9：明暗是反过来了，可所有的数都掉到了 0 以下，比黑还黑。再给每格加上 1，整张图就抬回 0 到 1 之间：−0.3 + 1 = 0.7，−0.9 + 1 = 0.1。所以「乘 −1 再加 1」就是 1 − 输入：原来越亮，现在越暗。
t.en: Why "1 minus the input"? Brightness always lies between 0 and 1. Multiply each cell by −1 alone and a dark 0.3 becomes −0.3 while a bright 0.9 becomes −0.9: light and dark are swapped, but every number has dropped below 0, darker than black. Add 1 to every cell and the whole picture is lifted back into 0 … 1: −0.3 + 1 = 0.7 and −0.9 + 1 = 0.1. So "multiply by −1, then add 1" is 1 − input: what was brighter is now darker.

t.zh: 这一关的元件都很朴素：<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>一直输出同一个数；<part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref><part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>把两样东西逐格乘起来、加起来。一个数和一张图相乘、相加时，这个数用在每一格上。
t.en: The parts in this level are all simple: <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref> always outputs the same number; <part-ref to="part:mul"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> multiply and add two things cell by cell. When a number meets a picture, the number applies to every cell.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：只用这些乘和加，凑出「1 减去输入」。
t.en: Your task in this level: using only these multiplications and additions, make "1 minus the input".
